import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Calculate effect sizes and p-values for all features
    effects = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if feats.types[i] == 'clinical':
            # For clinical features, use t-test
            y0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, i]
            y1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, i]
            t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(y0, y1, equal_var=False)
        else:
            # For other features, use Welch's t-test
            y0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, i]
            y1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, i]
            t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(y0, y1, equal_var=False)
        
        # Effect size: difference in means
        effect_size = np.mean(y1) - np.mean(y0)
        effects.append((fid, abs(effect_size), p_val, effect_size))
    
    # Sort by effect size (largest first)
    effects.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    
    # Select top features with significant p-values
    candidates = [e for e in effects if e[2] < 0.05]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates (correlated features)
    selected_ids = set()
    for fid, effect_size, p_val, effect in candidates:
        # Check if this feature is correlated with any already selected feature
        is_duplicate = False
        for selected_fid in selected_ids:
            col1 = feats.column(selected_fid)
            col2 = feats.column(fid)
            corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col1], feats.x[:, col2])[0, 1]
            if abs(corr) >= 0.6:
                is_duplicate = True
                break
        if not is_duplicate:
            selected_ids.add(fid)
    
    # If no significant features, return empty design
    if len(selected_ids) == 0:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Get top features by effect size
    selected_features = sorted([e for e in effects if e[0] in selected_ids], 
                              key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    
    # Select top drivers (at most MAX_DRIVERS)
    drivers = tuple(f[0] for f in selected_features[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    
    # All selected features for regression
    columns = tuple(f[0] for f in selected_features)
    
    # Check for potential interactions between top features
    products = []
    for i, fid1 in enumerate(columns[:3]):  # Limit to top few
        for fid2 in columns[i+1:]:
            # Add interaction term if both features are in the dataset
            products.append((fid1, fid2))
    
    # Create weighted score from top features
    loadings = {}
    for i, (fid, _, _, effect) in enumerate(selected_features[:5]):
        # Weight by effect size (sign matters)
        loadings[fid] = effect
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
